answer.route: The controller is authenticated and maps [Route("api/customer")] plus [HttpGet("{orderId}/retrySquareTransaction")], forwarding orderId as the query OrderUuid.
answer.missing_configuration: The handler first loads the order and checks that it belongs to the authenticated user. If Square AppId or CallbackUrl is null, empty, or whitespace, it returns CustomerSquareRetryResponse(success=0, link=null, sidlink=null, error="Square is not configured in the new API.").
answer.configured_amount: cents = ((int)Math.Round(order.Total * 100, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero)).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture). That cents value is inserted as a JSON string under amount_money.amount, with currency_code USD.
answer.callback: callback_url is formed by direct concatenation: configured CallbackUrl + "/customer/callback".
answer.payment_link: The handler assembles JSON containing amount_money, callback_url, client_id=Square AppId, notes="OrderID:<order.Uuid>", and options.supported_tender_types=["CREDIT_CARD"]. It URI-escapes the JSON and returns link="square-commerce-v1://payment/create?data=<escaped-json>".
answer.sidlink: It resolves order.TourTimeSlot!.Tour!.HomepageUrl when nonblank; otherwise it uses CustomerCheckout.PublicAppBaseUrl with trailing slashes removed, falling back to https://app.taggable.com, then appends /customer/collections.
answer.configured_response: CustomerSquareRetryResponse(success=1, link=<Square deep link>, sidlink=<resolved homepage link>); error uses the record default null. JSON property names are success, link, sidlink, error.
